{{Quote|The Yakas were once a simple and primitive people who lived on a planet neighboring Arkania.|Senior Anthropologist Mammon Hoole, ''The Essential Guide to Alien Species''|<ref name="TEGAS" />}}
'''Yaka'''<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Yaka]]|system=[[Yaka system/Legends|Yaka system]]|legends=1}}</ref> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEGAS" /> located in the [[Yaka system/Legends|Yaka system]], a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was situated near the [[Perave system]]<ref name="EGTPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Yaka]] [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TEGAS" /> members of which spoke the [[Yakan]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Yakan" />

At one point, the scientifically advanced [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] species of the Perave [[Star system/Legends|system's]] planet [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]] conquered the Yaka system,<ref name="EGTPM" /> including the planet Yaka.<ref name="CSWE Yaka">{{CSWECite|III|348|Yaka}}</ref> Subsequently, in [[490 BBY]], the Arkanians carried out a medical experiment<ref name="EGTPM" /> by forcibly<ref name="CSWE Yaka" /> implanting the Yakas, whom the former viewed as "mindless" beings,<ref name="TEGAS" /> with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Brain/Legends|brain links]]. The Yakas consequently became one of the most intelligent species in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EGTPM" /> [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]] eventually mentioned the Yakas' homeworld&mdash;the name of which was listed as "unknown"&mdash;in a description of the species that was eventually included in the [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''.<ref name="TEGAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The homeworld of the Yaka species was first mentioned in the [[2001]] reference book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]].<ref name="TEGAS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]] placed the Yaka system, and therefore the planet, in grid square M-8.<ref name="TEA" /> Fry has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the star systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent planets or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the homeworld of the Yakas to be named in accordance with the Yaka system.<ref name="Planetnamia" />
